subject: Marketplace addendum: order form redlines & billing sequencing
messages:

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace addendum redlines (ACME)

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our legal team attached redlines to the Marketplace Addendum and a short comment summary. High-level asks from procurement:

- Ensure fees can be passed through in a single consolidated invoice (we need a clear pass-through waterfall).
- Limit Redwood liability to the order form value (we can accept a carveout for gross negligence).
- Clarify data residency obligations for marketplace-brokered subscriptions (ACME needs EU processing guarantees).

Can you confirm Redwood’s position on pass-through invoicing and whether Redwood can accept a 30 day SLA for evidence requests (SOC2/attestation) from distributors? We’d like to get to a signed order form within two weeks if possible.

I attached ACME_Redlines_20261102.docx (redlines) and a short summary PDF. Let us know if we should route counters to marketplace-legal@orioncloud.com or directly to your contracts team.

Best,
Samantha Kim
Head of Partnerships — ACME Platform
Samantha.kim@acmeplatform.com

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the redlines and summary. We got the attachments and appreciate the clear asks. Looping in Ben (Partner Ops) and Laura (Contracts) so we can coordinate an internal review and come back with a clean counter and suggested language.

Preliminary notes from ops:
- Pass-through invoicing: we typically support a single invoice flow if the marketplace provides a verified settlement report; we need to confirm the exact waterfall you expect (platform fee -> reseller fee -> taxes). Can you share your expected billing waterfall sample?
- Evidence requests: we can commit to a 30-day turnaround for SOC2 artifacts for production incidents; for ongoing audit packages we usually ask for 45 days.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Redwood legal to produce a tracked counter with alternative liability cap language (Laura) — by 11/04.
2) Ben to define pass-through invoice mapping and example waterfall — by 11/05.
3) Joint call with ACME + Orion legal to resolve outstanding carveouts — propose 11/06 or 11/07.
4) Final sign-off and DocuSign — target 11/12.

If that timeline works, we’ll produce the redline set and a one-pager describing the billing mapping.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Marketplace addendum redlines (ACME) — legal review notes

Team — forwarding ACME’s redlines with my initial read. Key legal concerns:

1) Liability cap: ACME proposes to limit Redwood to order form fees for marketplace-brokered transactions. We should push for an exceptions carveout (gross negligence and willful misconduct) and a tolerable combined cap for repeated breaches. Suggested compromise: cap = greater of (12 months of fees or $1,000,000) but allow carveouts for severe misconduct.

2) Pass-through indemnities: ACME wants the marketplace reseller to flow claims upstream. We need clear indemnity flow and confirmation that Redwood’s obligations are limited to the value collected through the marketplace. Ask: can ACME accept indemnity coordination language where Redwood’s indemnity obligations are limited to Redwood-controlled misconduct?

3) Audit/evidence timing: 30 days for incident artifacts is reasonable; for full audit bundles set 45 days. Also require that extensive requests (more than 3 per year) be scoped and mutually agreed.

I will prepare tracked changes and a clean summary by COB 11/04. Ben — can you produce the billing waterfall sample and a short note on how taxes are handled for marketplace-subscriptions?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Marketplace addendum redlines (ACME) — proposed language

Laura — see inline suggested language below that I think balances our risk appetite with ACME’s requirements. I’ll produce a tracked document after we align on these lines: 

- Liability cap: Replace ACME proposed line with: "Except for liability arising from Redwood’s gross negligence or willful misconduct, Redwood’s aggregate liability to Customer arising out of this Addendum will not exceed the greater of (i) the total fees paid to Redwood under the applicable Order Form in the 12 months preceding the claim; or (ii) $1,000,000."

- Pass-through fees / invoicing: Add a section: "Marketplace Billing. Where Customer purchases Redwood services through a Marketplace reseller, Redwood will accept reasonably attributed settlement reports provided by the Marketplace to reconcile fees. Redwood’s liability for invoicing errors will be limited to correction of errors and reimbursement of amounts wrongly billed; Redwood will not be responsible for amounts not collected by the Marketplace."

- Indemnities: Add language to limit Redwood’s indemnity to claims directly resulting from Redwood’s breach or wrongful acts and require Marketplace to notify Redwood within 30 days of receiving third-party claims.

- Audit timing: "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to produce requested SOC2 artifacts within 30 days for incident-related requests and within 45 days for full audit packages. Extensive requests (more than 3 per calendar year) will be scoped and agreed in advance."

If you all approve these positions I’ll bake them into the tracked draft.

Kimberly Park
Senior Privacy & Security Counsel — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum redlines (ACME) — Redwood positions and next steps

Hi Samantha / David / Orion legal —

Thanks for your patience while we reviewed ACME’s redlines. Attached is a tracked counter (Redwood_Marketplace_Addendum_draft.pdf) with the positions Laura and Kimberly summarized below. High-level summary:

- Liability cap: Redwood proposes a combined cap equal to the greater of (12 months fees) or $1,000,000, with carveouts for gross negligence and willful misconduct. This is intended to address ACME’s concern while preserving protection for material wrongdoing.
- Pass-through invoicing: Redwood will accept settlement reports from the marketplace for reconciliation and will correct invoicing errors. Redwood disclaims responsibility for amounts not remitted by the marketplace; we propose contract language that makes the marketplace/reseller responsible for collection and flow-down indemnities.
- Evidence/audit timing: Redwood can commit to 30 days for incident-related SOC2 artifacts and 45 days for full audit bundles. We will limit extensive requests (more than 3 per year) and require scoping.

Next steps:
- Please review the attached tracked draft and the proposed billing waterfall example linked here: https://drive.redwood.com/marketplace/billing-waterfall-example (we included an example mapping for platform fee -> reseller fee -> taxes).
- Can Orion or ACME confirm whether the marketplace will supply production settlement reports as a precondition for consolidated invoicing? If yes we can move forward to signature once the marketplace confirms collection responsibilities.
- Proposed call: Mon 11/09 09:00 PT to resolve open indemnity language and billing waterfall. I’ll send a calendar invite if that works.

Thanks — we want to keep this timeline tight and can ship the final counters within 48 hours after the call.

Warmly,
Tessa Morgan
Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_Addendum_draft.pdf (tracked), Billing_Waterfall_Example.xlsx (link)
